# Entorhinal role lease vectors

`role-lease-v1/` is copied byte for byte from Entorhinal's
`test-vectors/role-lease-v1/` at tag `hub-only-samples-v1` (also tagged
`role-lease-v1.5`), commit `291c1eddafaad4098309a8c28c23d62aaa1e1a64`.

The upstream `SHA256SUMS` has SHA-256
`ef9c599ae771b32390b71bb38f5355269bae90fba18defa0ac8c0c31afd6bf31`.
Run `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` from `role-lease-v1/` to verify the JSON
samples. To update the pin, copy the upstream directory unchanged and record
its tag, commit, and checksum here.
